tool.name: all_time_totals
tool.title: All-time totals
tool.description: All-time (lifetime) totals for the account or one program: partners, clicks, leads, customers, paying customers, transactions, revenue, refunds and commissions. commissions is approved + paid (also split into commissions_approved and commissions_paid); pending commissions are not included, use commission_status_breakdown for those. Use this whenever the user asks for all-time, lifetime, total-ever or since-launch numbers, instead of widening a date window on the other report tools. Built from Tolt's pre-aggregated partner metrics, refreshed every few minutes (clicks_updated_at shows the last click refresh). Money is integer minor units in `currency`; when the account has several program currencies, currency is null and amounts are summed across them, so pass program_id for exact money. Result fields: partners, clicks, leads, customers, paying_customers, transactions, revenue, refunded, commissions, commissions_paid, commissions_approved, clicks_updated_at, currency, currencies.

tool.description: Fetch one invoice by id. Returns its number, name, description, status, type (off_cycle, or null for a regular payout invoice), payment method, payout count, program and paid date. Tolt bills invoices in USD: base_amount, processing_fee_amount and total_amount are strings in USD minor units, and processing_fee_rate is a fraction. Result fields: id, invoice_number, name, description, amount, base_amount, total_amount, processing_fee_amount, processing_fee_rate, currency, status, type, payment_method, payout_count, program_id, paid_at, created_at, updated_at.

type.description: off_cycle for an invoice created outside the regular payout schedule; null for a regular payout invoice.

amount.description: Older amount column as stored, or null; use base_amount, processing_fee_amount and total_amount for the invoice totals.

status.description: Invoice status as stored, such as draft or paid, or null.

paid_at.description: When the invoice was paid, as an ISO 8601 timestamp, or null.

currency.description: Currency code stored on the invoice. Tolt bills invoices in USD, the currency of the amounts above.

created_at.description: When the invoice was created, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

program_id.description: Id of the program it belongs to (prg_...), or null.

updated_at.description: When the invoice last changed, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

base_amount.description: Payouts subtotal in USD minor units, as a numeric string.

payout_count.description: Number of payouts on the invoice.

total_amount.description: Total due in USD minor units, base plus processing fee, as a numeric string.

payment_method.description: How the invoice is paid: card, us_bank_account or custom, or null.

processing_fee_rate.description: Processing fee rate as a fraction (0.03 = 3%), as a numeric string.

processing_fee_amount.description: Processing fee in USD minor units, as a numeric string.

tool.description: Run commission flows again for a batch of transactions in one call, so the user approves the whole batch once. Pass every transaction to rerun, and split into more calls only when the list is longer than one call accepts. Transactions that are refunded or already have a commission are skipped and reported, so no duplicates are created. Returns succeeded and failed counts with a result per id; skipped transactions carry a code such as commission_exists or transaction_refunded. The app asks the user to approve this call before it runs, so call it directly instead of asking for confirmation in text.
